name: Dwarven Centurion

abilities.name: Axe
abilities.description: The centurion swings its left axe-arm as a basic melee attack, dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Hammer
abilities.description: The centurion swings its right arm as a slow basic melee attack, dealing moderate-high physical damage.

abilities.name: Steam Breath
abilities.description: The centurion releases steam, as indicated by a red cone in front of itself, dealing 4 ticks of moderate flame damage over time to all targets standing in the cone.

abilities.name: Sweeping Spin
abilities.description: The centurion spins around, as indicated by a red circle, dealing moderate-high physical damage as well as knocking down all targets within. Blocking negates the knockdown. This only used if a target is very close to the Dwarven Centurion.

abilities.name: Overcharge
abilities.description: If charged when destroyed, the centurion will explode, dealing moderate shock damage to all targets around it as indicated by a red circle. This only occurs if the centurion has been charged by a dwarven spider. (blue textures on their framing)

summary: Dwarven Centurions are hostile humanoid dwarven automatons, usually found in Dwemer ruins. However, unlike dwarven spiders and dwarven spheres, they are not found in every one. For example, they cannot be found in Lower Bthanual or Mzithumz.
